# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6b. Logit-level inter-generational KL divergence
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def compute_logit_kl_divergence(
    model_curr: torch.nn.Module,
    model_prev: torch.nn.Module,
    dataloader: DataLoader,
    num_samples: int = 2_000,
    device: str = "cuda",
) -> Dict[str, float]:
    """KL(P_prev || P_curr) at the full logit distribution level on the same inputs.

    Feeds the same held-out batches to both models, computes per-token KL
    divergence between their next-token probability distributions.
    """
    model_curr.eval()
    model_prev.eval()
    kl_values = []
    seen = 0

    with torch.no_grad():
        for batch in tqdm(dataloader, desc="logit-kl", leave=False):
            if seen >= num_samples:
                break
            input_ids = batch["input_ids"].to(device)
            attn_mask = batch["attention_mask"].to(device)

            logits_curr = model_curr(input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attn_mask).logits
            logits_prev = model_prev(input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attn_mask).logits

            # shift: predict position t+1 from position t
            logits_curr = logits_curr[:, :-1, :].float()
            logits_prev = logits_prev[:, :-1, :].float()
            mask = attn_mask[:, 1:].bool()

            log_p = F.log_softmax(logits_prev, dim=-1)
            log_q = F.log_softmax(logits_curr, dim=-1)
            p = log_p.exp()

            # KL(P_prev || P_curr) = sum_x p(x) * (log p(x) - log q(x))
            kl = (p * (log_p - log_q)).sum(dim=-1)  # (B, L-1)

            for i in range(kl.shape[0]):
                kl_values.append(kl[i][mask[i]].cpu())
            seen += input_ids.shape[0]

    all_kl = torch.cat(kl_values).float()
    return {
        "logit_kl_mean": all_kl.mean().item(),
        "logit_kl_var": all_kl.var().item(),
        "logit_kl_std": all_kl.std().item(),
        "logit_kl_median": all_kl.median().item(),
        "logit_kl_max": all_kl.max().item(),
        "logit_kl_p90": all_kl.quantile(0.9).item(),
        "logit_kl_p99": all_kl.quantile(0.99).item(),
        "logit_kl_num_tokens": int(all_kl.shape[0]),
    }
